title: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Classic ragù simmered low and slow, served over spaghetti.

steps.title: Chop sofrito
steps.body: Finely dice {{ onion.name }}, {{ carrot.name }}, and {{ celery.name }}. Mince {{ garlic.name }}.

steps.title: Render pancetta
steps.body: Heat {{ olive_oil }} in a heavy pot, add {{ pancetta }} and cook until fat renders, ~5 minutes.

steps.title: Soften vegetables
steps.body: Add the sofrito from @step(1) and cook 8–10 minutes until soft and golden.

steps.title: Brown beef
steps.body: Push veg aside, add {{ beef }} and brown well, breaking up clumps.

steps.title: Deglaze and simmer
steps.body: Pour in {{ wine }} and reduce by half. Add {{ tomatoes }} and {{ milk }}, season, then simmer uncovered for @timer(75m).

steps.title: Boil pasta water
steps.body: While the sauce simmers, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.

steps.title: Cook spaghetti
steps.body: Cook {{ spaghetti }} al dente, ~@timer(9m). Reserve a cup of pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Combine and serve
steps.body: Toss the drained spaghetti from @step(7) with the bolognese from @step(5), loosening with pasta water as needed. Serve topped with {{ parmesan }}.
